scope: All 600 existing question texts, answer sets and explanations were read alongside the 150 proposed additions. Distinct facts and reverse formulations were compared, not just question strings. High-overlap candidate pairs received a separate review.
limits: Editorial review, not empirical difficulty calibration or a mathematical proof of semantic uniqueness. Book chapter references identify the canon; HP Lexicon is an independent secondary cross-reference, not an official publisher.
rejectedDrafts: Mirror of Erised question with both Head Boy and Quidditch captain offered as answers
Incorrect Hufflepuff attribution to Penelope Clearwater
Rita/Hagrid parentage and Umbridge/Quibbler candidates that repeated existing coverage
Unverified examination transformation and hoop-colour candidates
Medium-difficulty final-round candidates replaced with obscure book details

targetedExistingReplacement.reason: The old choices were homophones, making it unsuitable for VoiceOver. Replace one existing fact explicitly without enlarging or silently replacing the existing collection.

similarityMethod: Meaningful tokens from the question, correct answer and fact key; common book-title and question words excluded. All 61 pairs at Jaccard overlap >= 0.37 reviewed. Separate full-bank editorial comparison covers candidates below this threshold.
